reference: Independent python implementation of the constant-gamma compressible-flow relations (NACA Report 1135) plus an exact ideal-gas Riemann solver (Toro Ch.4); every value re-derived a second, structurally different way (raw conservation balances / numerical quadrature / ODE integration) and recorded as crosscheck.
citations: Ames Research Staff, "Equations, Tables, and Charts for Compressible Flow", NACA Report 1135, 1953: eq.(44) isentropic, eq.(80) area ratio, eq.(93)-(99) normal shock, eq.(138) theta-beta-M, eq.(171a) Prandtl-Meyer; Table I (isentropic) and Table II (normal shock) used for spot checks.
A. H. Shapiro, "The Dynamics and Thermodynamics of Compressible Fluid Flow", Vol. I, Ronald Press, 1953, Ch. 6 (Fanno line) and Ch. 7 (Rayleigh line).

E. F. Toro, "Riemann Solvers and Numerical Methods for Fluid Dynamics", 3rd ed., Springer 2009, Ch. 4 (exact Riemann solver) and Table 4.1 (Sod problem: p*=0.30313, u*=0.92745, rho*L=0.42632, rho*R=0.26557).
